name: reinforced tool
description: Whatever you had, wrapped, weighted and bound at the bench until it became a weapon. It is yours in a way a found thing never is — and it is the one you can bring back.
notes: T80 · the one artifact the crafting economy mints (recipe.weapon.reinforce-tool). T81 leaves it OUT of every loot table (lootWeight 0): the bench is how you get one, and that is its distinction now that the world hands out weapons — it starts and repairs to a full 100, where a found weapon starts below it.
